sponsor_or_proposer: Government of Peru — Ministry of Energy and Mines (MINEM) / Proinversión (tendering agency); no private sponsor awarded yet
current_state: Pre-tender planning. In March 2026 Energy & Mines Minister Angelo Alfaro announced the government will task Proinversión with launching a bid (convocatoria) to build an LNG import/regasification plant to strengthen energy security against gas-supply contingencies; technical studies described as 'advanced'; tender to launch 'in the short term', infrastructure expected ready in ~2 years (~2028). Part of Proinversión's US$2,900M 2026-2027 natural-gas APP project portfolio.
missing_threshold_elements: No awarded private sponsor/developer; no confirmed exact site (search snippet of EL COMERCIO suggests near Melchorita ~170 km south of Lima, but body sources do not confirm a specific location); no capacity figure; onshore-vs-FSRU configuration not finalized (most sources describe an onshore regasification plant fed by LNG carriers); no FID, license, or tender award.
watch_for: Proinversión tender publication (convocatoria) and award; named private concessionaire; confirmed site/coordinates; capacity (MTPA / regas Mcm-d); whether onshore terminal or chartered FSRU; FID. If an FSRU is chartered to Peru, treat as immediate terminal lead and run fsru_sync_check.
notes: GENUINE GAP: GEM has only Peru LNG (export, operating) and Ilo (export, shelved) — no import/regas terminal for Peru. This would be Peru's first LNG import terminal. Below the firm new_terminal bar (government proposal, no sponsor/site/capacity), so staged as monitor.
